title: Policy-Aligned Predictive Verification for Adaptive VLA Action-Chunk Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.21434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate action sequences that reduce repeated inference, but deciding how much of each sequence to execute is critical to task success. Existing adaptive methods make this decision using generation stability or prediction agreement, yet these signals do not establish whether executing a candidate prefix preserves the ability to complete the task. We introduce a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that anticipates the consequences of candidate action prefixes and evaluates their compatibility with successful continuation before execution. Rather than using future prediction to generate actions, our method evaluates existing proposals in the VLA's internal task-conditioned representation space. To learn local judgments from terminal task outcomes, we combine trajectory-level survival supervision with a localization prior that preserves useful behavior within failed rollouts. translated_title: 面向自适应VLA动作块执行的策略对齐预测验证
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过生成动作序列来减少重复推理，但决定每个序列应执行多少部分对任务成功至关重要。现有的自适应方法依据生成稳定性或预测一致性来做出这一决策，然而这些信号无法确定执行某个候选前缀是否能保持完成任务的能力。我们提出了一种策略对齐预测验证器（PAV），它能够在执行前预判候选动作前缀的后果，并评估其与成功后续行动的兼容性。我们的方法并非利用未来预测来生成动作，而是在VLA内部的任务条件表征空间中对已有提议进行评估。为了从终端任务结果中学习局部判断，我们将轨迹级生存监督与一种定位先验相结合，该先验能够在失败的执行轨迹中保留有用的行为。由此得到的有效（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出策略对齐预测验证器（PAV），在执行前于VLA内部任务条件表征空间中预判候选动作前缀的后果并评估其与任务成功后续行动的兼容性，从而实现更可靠的自适应动作块执行决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that anticipates the consequences of candidate action prefixes and evaluates their compatibility with successful task continuation in the VLA's internal task-conditioned representation space, enabling more reliable adaptive decision-making for action-chunk execution.
